_about: What We Do score errata and by-ear choices (score seconds). 'lead_part' makes the lead follow one part in [start, end); 'legato' times its notes as a slow sung line. 'chord_passages' (audio seconds): stretches where every note the band attacks together is a chord (mode 'all': every note; 'holds': only held notes).

lead_part.why: WWD 3:32-4:00 (mm.65-75): the trombones' slow sustained tune is what the ear follows, under the busier marimba / piccolo / flute ostinati that the rules would pick (user approved earlier; to be re-confirmed by ear).
WWD 4:25-4:53 (mm.85-100): the bagpipes' climax tune is what the ear follows over the busy parts (user approved earlier; to be re-confirmed by ear).

chord_passages.why: 0:00-0:18: the opening marimba plays chords that the score only gives as single notes (user, by ear).
